threshold: probable contamination: best bacterial hit identity
basis: gap in distribution: 79.1% (F. langsethiae ocs, non-T-DNA candidate) → 90.5% (Mortierella mas2); no value in between among 116 proteins
what_changes_outside: ≤79%: F. langsethiae ocs (79.1) and nos (78.0) move non-T-DNA candidate → probable contamination (+ more below 75%: 14 at 75%); >90.4%: Mortierella mas2 (90.5) probable contamination → other bacterial-type protein (10 at 95%)

threshold: bacterial-type protein: non-fungal among 50 best hits
basis: stability range (bimodal: bacterial-type proteins 37–50, members of families with a single better bacterial hit mostly <35)
what_changes_outside: >37: Melanogaster sus (37/50) T-DNA candidate → member of a family with a single better bacterial hit; at 45: 5 proteins change (Melanogaster sus, Pleurotus acs ×2 → member of a family with a single better bacterial hit, Butyriboletus nos, Kwoniella vis)

threshold: bacterial-type protein: bit-score margin bacterial/plant − fungal
basis: gap in distribution: no protein with margin 39–63 bits (38 Ambispora → 64 Leucoagaricus); Beauveria nos/ocs/vis margins 5–17 bits, far below
what_changes_outside: <39: Ambispora chs (38) member of a family with a single better bacterial hit → other bacterial-type protein; ≤32: + Mycena nos/vis (32); ≤28: Aspergillus chs RAL15815 → non-T-DNA candidate; ≤23 Trichosporon mas1; ≤16 Beauveria nos/vis (single species); >64: Leucoagaricus acs (64) other bacterial-type protein → member of a family with a single better bacterial hit; ≥70–80: Rhypophila nos, Butyriboletus nos T-DNA candidate → member of a family with a single better bacterial hit

threshold: T-DNA candidate: identity to T-DNA seed
basis: stability range (narrow): lower edge Leucoagaricus acs 30.1%, upper edge Rhypophila nos 36.0%

threshold: T-DNA candidate: coverage of T-DNA seed
basis: stability range; Fusarium chs proteins with cov 0.29 pass via gene×genus propagation

threshold: T-DNA candidate: seed identity ≥ ratio × best bacterial identity
what_changes_outside: >0.91: Rhypophila nos (ratio 0.911) T-DNA candidate → other bacterial-type protein; at 1.0 also Dactylonectria chs, Amanita & Hebeloma cus (T-DNA candidate → non-T-DNA candidate), 6 changes; <0.56: Cutaneotrichosporon mas1 other bacterial-type protein → T-DNA candidate

threshold: non-T-DNA candidate: best Rhizobiales hit identity
basis: stability range: Kwoniella vis (Bosea, 42.5%) below, Pleurotus acs (Ensifer, 51.0%) above
